summary: Retested the duplicate-toast fix (toast.message id = 'ir-inline-align-soon') on AlignPanel INLINE stub at 1280x900 on fullscreen Format editor of 'Deep note'. The dedupe fix did NOT eliminate the duplicate toast. Root cause found: TWO <Toaster /> sonner components are mounted in the DOM (one in App.js:46 and one in NotesApp.jsx:3086). Each Toaster is an independent render sink, so a single toast.message(...) call renders ONE toast per Toaster, producing 2 visible <li data-sonner-toast> elements. Sonner's id-based dedupe only collapses duplicates WITHIN a single Toaster instance, not across multiple Toasters. All other 8 iteration_115 regression scenarios continue to PASS.

ui_bugs.issue: DUPLICATE <Toaster /> MOUNT. Two sonner Toasters are mounted simultaneously (App.js L46 and NotesApp.jsx L3086), so every toast.message/toast.success/etc. call in the app renders twice. This defeats sonner's id-based dedupe (the ir-inline-align-soon id dedupes within a Toaster, not across). Affects not just inline-align stub but potentially every other toast in the app.

action_items: Remove ONE of the two <Toaster /> mounts. Recommended: delete the one at /app/frontend/src/NotesApp.jsx:3086 and keep the root-level one at /app/frontend/src/App.js:46 (or vice-versa). After removal, confirm `document.querySelectorAll('[data-sonner-toaster]').length === 1` and the inline-align single-tap renders exactly 1 toast. The already-applied id='ir-inline-align-soon' on toast.message in FloatingRichTextToolbar.jsx should be kept — it will correctly dedupe any legit double-invocation within the single remaining Toaster.
Audit other toast call sites across the app — since every toast has been doubling until now, user-reported 'duplicate toast' complaints are likely global, not alignment-specific.

rca of the issue: Root cause of duplicate inline-stub toast: dual mount of sonner <Toaster /> component in the app tree. (1) /app/frontend/src/App.js line 46: <Toaster position="bottom-right" />. (2) /app/frontend/src/NotesApp.jsx line 3086: <Toaster position="bottom-right" theme={isDark ? "dark" : "light"} />. Sonner Toaster listens to the global toast() event bus; each mounted Toaster independently renders a <li data-sonner-toast> for every toast call. toast(..., { id }) only prevents duplicates WITHIN one Toaster. Mitigation: delete one of the two <Toaster /> JSX nodes. Expected outcome after fix: single-tap INLINE alignment produces exactly 1 toast element, and all other app toasts (save confirmations, errors, etc.) also stop doubling.
